headline: Mangalam Global Enterprise reports 41.85% YoY rise in Q2 PBT
hook: Profit rises as distribution footprint widens
summary: Mangalam Global Enterprise Limited reported its financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Profit before tax (PBT) grew 41.85% year-on-year to Rs 12.27 crore. The company also highlighted the expansion of its NEAT Everyday brand presence across India during the period. Indian retail investors tracking small-cap agro-commodity and consumer goods players can observe margin trends and regional scaling.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings growth highlights operational scaling for small-cap holders
winners_losers: Mangalam Global shareholders gain / none hurt
